summary: Frontend-only functional QA of /projects pagination and filters against real seeded fixtures, plus regression on /invoices and /customers hrefFor pagination callbacks. Seeded 55 QA54_ projects (14 active, 14 on_hold, 14 completed, 13 archived; createdAt spanning last 60 days; one long-unbreakable-name fixture) in demo org fa82eab8-... via SQLite. Verified pagination counts with real assertions, filter behaviour, clear behaviour, and horizontal overflow at desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844. Fixtures cleaned after run (final count QA54 rows = 0). Note: due to the broad scope of the review request, only /projects functional pagination + /invoices & /customers regression were fully executed; banking/employees/office-tasks/office-docs/office-fees fixture-based deep functional tests were NOT executed in this iteration.

ui_bugs.issue: Prev/Next Link href is always built as `page: page - 1` / `page + 1` even when the button is disabled. On page 1 the prev href renders as `?page=0` (invalid); on the last page the next href renders as `page=pages+1` (e.g. observed /projects?pageSize=50&page=3 on last page where pages=2). Buttons are visually disabled via pointer-events-none/aria-disabled so users cannot click, but the href is still crawlable/tab-focus-followable in some AT/keyboard scenarios and produces an invalid URL.

hrefFor callback passed to <ListPagination> reduces the patch to `{ page, pageSize }` and forwards empty strings for missing keys (`p.pageSize ? String(p.pageSize) : ""`). In linkFor the `...params` spread OVERRIDES the outer pageSize with `""` and the `if (v)` guard then drops it. Consequence: clicking Prev/Next in /customers when pageSize != 25 will strip pageSize back to the default 25 — the exact bug called out in the review. Not reproducible against live data today (12 customers → single page) but the defect is present in source. Fix: only forward defined keys, e.g. `linkFor(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(p).filter(([,v]) => v!==undefined).map(([k,v])=>[k,String(v)])))`.

Out-of-range page numbers are NOT clamped — /invoices?pageSize=50&page=2 (only 33 invoices, so page 2 is empty) renders the generic "Δεν βρέθηκαν παραστατικά" empty-state without a ListPagination bar and without a way for the user to go back to page 1. /projects (in-memory paginate) correctly clamps page=999 to the last populated page. listInvoices in the invoices code path uses DB-side LIMIT/OFFSET and does not clamp.

action_items: Fix /customers hrefFor at customers/page.tsx:162 so page-prev / page-next preserve pageSize (HIGH — user-facing regression when pageSize is set).
Clamp out-of-range page in /invoices (invoices/page.tsx / listInvoices) to last populated page instead of showing generic empty-state. Match /projects behaviour.
In shared list-pagination.tsx, gate raw href computation with `page>1` / `page<pages` (or use `Math.max/Math.min`) so disabled prev/next don't render page=0 or page>pages URLs.
critical_code_review_comments: customers/page.tsx line 162: `linkFor({ page: p.page ? String(p.page) : "", pageSize: p.pageSize ? String(p.pageSize) : "" })` breaks the ListPagination contract — it forwards explicit empty strings which then override the outer pageSize in the linkFor spread. This is the exact 'hrefFor callbacks clear pageSize on page navigation' issue the reviewer suspected.

list-pagination.tsx: use `hrefFor({ page: Math.max(1, page-1) })` and `hrefFor({ page: Math.min(pages, page+1) })` so disabled links still resolve to valid URLs (nice-to-have; button is already visually disabled).
invoices/page.tsx listInvoices uses DB LIMIT/OFFSET without clamping — inconsistent with in-memory paginate() used by /projects and /customers.

hrefWith in lib/list-params.ts correctly drops empty values but the callers must not spread patches with empty strings into it (see customers bug). Consider making hrefWith accept a filter callback so callers can't accidentally clobber preserved params.
Prev/next href is deterministic regardless of enabled state — okay because of pointer-events-none, but exposes invalid ?page=0 / ?page>pages URLs to search engines / a11y tools.

rca_of_the_issue: customers hrefFor bug RCA: ListPagination invokes hrefFor with a partial patch (only `page` on Prev/Next; only `pageSize`+`page` on page-size links). The customers callback wraps this and forwards missing keys as literal empty strings ("") into linkFor, whose outer merge sets pageSize to the current value but the trailing `...params` spread then overwrites it with "" and the `if (v) u.set(...)` drops empty values → pageSize disappears from the resulting URL. Repro (needs >25 customers): /customers?pageSize=50 → click Next → URL becomes /customers?page=2 (pageSize=50 lost). Mitigation: strip undefined-only keys before spreading, or invert precedence so explicit non-empty values win. Same anti-pattern is NOT present in /projects (uses hrefWith which naturally drops empty values from BOTH sides) — that's why /projects Prev/Next works.
